main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 3-bar forward return on forecast (rising-profile grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and mean unusual move > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move (strength) of long cases

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the mean unusual move of the forecast > 0 cases is above 0.
reading: Rising profile read as regime not 'chop'; excess return uses the coin's mean 3-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; supporting-check cases are the workflow's long bets (forecast rise >= 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet), one per 3-bar grid cell, strength = (return - drift) / the coin's 3-bar std; the plan's 'fewer than 100 is inconclusive' minimum is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0004702 on the check folds against +0.001088 on every fold
